title: Cartesian Time Interval Extent
description: Spatiotemporal interval coordinates in Cartesian space with start times and durations.

time.description: Array of interval start times in seconds.

duration.description: Array of interval durations in seconds.

disjoint.description: Indicates whether time intervals at identical spatial coordinates are non-overlapping.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether time intervals cover the time range without gaps.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.

min_x.description: Lower bound along x-axis in space.

max_x.description: Upper bound along x-axis in space.

min_y.description: Lower bound along y-axis in space.

max_y.description: Upper bound along y-axis in space.

min_z.description: Lower bound along z-axis in space.

max_z.description: Upper bound along z-axis in space.
